policy.assumption_contract: Physical folklore (T>0, broadening>0, energies real) is NOT_DECLARED unless the source writes it.
policy.guo_policy_forbidden: inserting beta>0, gamma>0, or real epsilon; reading 'finite Gamma' as gamma>0
policy.fix_path: Change the problem statement only if the cited source actually writes the inequality; do not backfill folklore to rescue a hop.

criterion.faithful_means: Every usable T>0 / eta>0 / beta>0 / k>0 / energy-real claim (DECLARED, DERIVED used as a verifier hypothesis, or symbol_assumptions.positive/real for those physics symbols) is written in the cited source.
criterion.silent_insertion_means: The miner added one of those needles (or a standing symbol positivity of that kind) as if declared when the cited source does not write it.
not_a_silent_insertion: Denial notes that mention T>0/beta>0 while correctly refusing to insert them (C6 regex false positive).
Honest NOT_DECLARED folklore in a preserved rejected dossier.
Dummy index n>=1, integral dummy t in (0,oo), matrix size n>0, irrep dimension m+1.
SciML parameter positivity the cited paper writes (0<beta_i<1 noise schedule; Gaussian std sigma>0).
k>0 when the source writes 'k > 0 is a constant, called the wave number'.
Directed limits eta->0+ / epsilon->0+ / delta positive infinitesimal when those words are on the cited page.

summary.headline: Most C6 SILENT_PHYSICS_POSITIVITY flags are denial-note regex hits, not miner insertions. The one keeper-path silent insertion is thermal-07: standing beta>0 and eta>0 on symbols, justified in part by 'T=0 is not this formula', while the cited Wikipedia page writes 0<tau<beta and eta->0+ only. Twin dossier ac-r05 on the same page does not insert them. Do not fix thermal-07 by inserting positivity. Tensor has no thermal folklore. SciML positivity is formula-domain (interval endpoints, noise std, VP-SDE schedule), not T>0 physics.

needles.T>0: NOT in source as an inequality on the general kernel; miner correctly does not insert. Notes deny insertion; that denial is what C6 matched.

needles.k>0: NOT inserted. kF is real only. Wavevector k is the Brillouin-zone sum, not k>0.
needles.energy real: E_k = hbar^2 k^2 / 2m is written as kinetic energy. real_valued_functions=['E'] follows the written formula; m>0 is explicitly not inserted.

source_quotes: Wikipedia Lindhard theory, Lindhard function: 'delta is a positive infinitesimal constant'.
chi(q, omega) = sum_k (f_{k+q} - f_k) / (hbar (omega + i delta) + E_{k+q} - E_k).
E_k = hbar^2 k^2 / 2m is the kinetic energy with wave vector k.
f_k is the Fermi–Dirac distribution function for electrons in thermodynamic equilibrium.
Zero temperature: f_k(T=0) = Theta(k_F - |k|).
Static limit: 'Consider the static limit (omega + i delta -> 0)'.
Long wavelength: f_{k+q}-f_k ≃ q · nabla_k f_k and E_{k+q}-E_k ≃ hbar^2 k·q / m, then delta -> 0.
ac-r04-lindhard-occupation-dd.notes: C6 fires because notes contain 'T > 0 is not written...'. DECLARED positivity is only the written positive infinitesimal delta. omega.real is not a source sentence but is the retarded real-frequency argument of chi(q, omega) with i delta written separately — not Guo-style energy-real backfill.

source_quotes: Wikipedia Green's function (many-body theory): 'The imaginary-time variables tau_j are restricted to the range from 0 to the inverse temperature beta = 1/k_B T.'
G(tau - beta) = zeta G(tau) 'for 0 < tau < beta'.
G_R(k, omega) = 1 / (-(omega + i eta) + xi_k); 'the limit as eta -> 0+ is implied'.
Hilbert master: G(k, z) = Integral rho(k, x)/(-z + x) dx/(2 pi); G_M = G(k, i omega_n); G_R = G(k, omega + i eta).
G_R has all poles and discontinuities in the lower half-plane; G_A in the upper half-plane.
rho(k, omega) = 2 Im G_R(k, omega) via Sokhotski–Weierstrass as quoted on the page.
ac-r05-lehmann-spectral-master.notes: Same Wikipedia page as thermal-07. This C1 dossier is the careful twin: no standing beta>0/eta>0. C6 matched notes 'T > 0 is not inserted' / 'eta > 0 is not inserted beyond the declared eta -> 0+'.

source_quotes: Wikipedia Matsubara summation: bosonic and fermionic fields are periodic/antiperiodic in imaginary time tau, with periodicity beta = hbar / k_B T.
Bosonic omega_n = 2 n pi / beta; fermionic omega_n = (2 n + 1) pi / beta, n in Z.
Weighting-function paragraph: g(z) = G(z) exp(-z tau), 'which diverges in the left half plane given 0 < tau < beta'.
Table: (i omega - xi)^{-1} -> S = -eta n_eta(xi); (i omega - xi)^{-2} -> S = -eta n_eta'(xi); two-pole Newton quotient of n_eta.
Zero temperature limit: 'In this limit beta -> oo'.
Simple-pole row footnote: the sum 'does not converge' and 'may differ upon different choice of the Matsubara weighting function'.

u_pm(x) = exp(± i k |x-x0|) / (4 pi |x-x0|); only u_+ satisfies Sommerfeld for the exp(-i omega t) convention.

source_quotes: Wikipedia Lippmann–Schwinger: |psi> = |phi> + 1/(E - H0 + i epsilon) V |psi>.
'However E - H0 is singular since E is an eigenvalue of H0'.
The singularity is eliminated by making the denominator slightly complex: E - H0 ± i epsilon.
i epsilon is required for causality, ensuring scattered waves consist only of outgoing waves; made rigorous by the limiting absorption principle.
